name: Maze of Runes
prerequisites: legendary in Arcana, Nature, Occultism, or Religion
text: You can trap a foe in a twisting, extradimensional labyrinth of ever-shifting runes. You can cast Quandary once per day as an innate spell. The rank of this spell is equal to half your level rounded up, and the tradition can be any tradition for which you are at least legendary in the related skill. Instead of the usual skill checks to solve the puzzle, the target of your quandary can attempt a Perception check check, a Society check to decipher-writing, or a check in the skill related to the tradition of the spell. When you Sustain this spell, you can also Trace a Rune or Invoke one Rune on the target creature as if it were adjacent to you.
